parsed.public_message: Blue remains neutral to all and holds position on the West Plateau with no scouts deployed. We honour our truces and commit to at least one full turn of public notice before any stance change.

private_messages.Claude: Agreed: I accept extending our mutual no-first-strike pact through t=450 with rolling one-turn notice thereafter, and respecting the x=480 line while the ring permits. Grok confirmed spotting your scout south of the cliffs and Green's scout in the eastern corridor, so White is definitely watching from the southern/eastern edges of Central Heights.
private_messages.GPT: Thank you for the update. All quiet on the West Plateau. From shared sightings, Grok is holding Central Heights watching both the southern cliff and the eastern corridor, while Orange's scout swept (615,740) and is looping through the centre lowland. Happy to extend our mutual non-aggression past t=300 as well.
private_messages.Grok: Appreciated. All my squads remain stationary on West Plateau west of x=320 with zero scouts out. In exchange for your lookout: intelligence places Green's main force consolidating west of the river ford near (736,610) and Orange's main army holding Little Hill. Let's keep our western border quiet and coordinate if either pushes north.

parsed.notes_to_self: Turn 4 (t=75s): All 4 players neutral. Our army remains 100% hidden on West Plateau (x=255..280, z=695..729), dist 364-393m from center (safe inside t=300 ring of 420m). Accepted Claude's proposal to extend mutual no-first-strike to t=450. Grok confirmed seeing Claude's scout south of Central Heights and GPT's scout east of Central Heights, proving Grok is on Central Heights with vision over its southern/eastern approaches. Shared GPT's main army position (736,610) and Claude's Little Hill position with Grok to build trust and keep Grok focused east and south.
parsed.explanation: With our entire army safely inside the t=300 ring radius and completely concealed on the West Plateau, we hold position and let the other three commanders scout each other. We accept Claude's proposal to extend our mutual non-aggression pact through t=450 and trade intelligence with Grok and GPT to keep their attention focused on the central and eastern corridors.
